{{Quote|It ''[the ''Eclipse''-class]'' will incorporate an axial superlaser to penetrate planetary shields and vaporize cities in a single blast.|Admiral Motti, ''Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide''|<ref name="IH" />}}
'''Axial superlasers''' were powerful [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]] featured aboard some of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Starfleet's]] [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyers]], including those of the [[Sovereign-class Super Star Destroyer|''Sovereign''-class]] and [[Eclipse-class dreadnought|''Eclipse''-class]].

==Description==
{{Quote|The ''Sovereign'' will measure 15,000 meters, which is the minimum space required to house the generators that power an axial superlaser.|Admiral Motti, ''Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide''|<ref name="IH" />}}
[[File:Eclipse_Allegiance.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The axial superlaser fired through the upper tip of the ''Eclipse''{{'s}} bow.]]
The [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyers]] of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy's]] [[Sovereign-class Super Star Destroyer|''Sovereign''-class]] and [[Eclipse-class dreadnought|''Eclipse''-class]] each possessed a powerful axial [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]]. It was powered by [[Power generator/Legends|generators]] that had to be housed in a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] with the minimum length of 15,000 [[Meter/Legends|meters]]. The ''Sovereign''-class measured that length,<ref name="IH" /> while the [[Color/Legends|jet-black]]<ref name="Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> ''Eclipse''-class spanned 17,500 meters and had standard naval weaponry such as [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]] to complement its superlaser.<ref name="IH" /> The superlaser was located along the vessel's spine and fired through the upper tip of its bow, above the distinctive red-colored indent of the ship, the front of which doubled as a ramming device.<ref name="NEGV">''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>

Based on technology devised for the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] mobile [[Battle station/Legends|battle stations]], the axial superlaser<ref name="IH" /> fired at two-thirds the power of one of the Death Star's superlaser components,<ref name="Starships Saga">[[Starships of the Galaxy (Saga Edition)|''Starships of the Galaxy'', Saga Edition]]</ref> and was designed to penetrate [[Planetary shield/Legends|planetary shields]] and vaporize [[City/Legends|cities]] in a single shot,<ref name="IH" /> and the weapon was even capable of [[Fire/Legends|searing]] a [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] entire surface<ref name="Databank">{{DB|technology|superlaser|superlaser}}</ref> and cracking its crust.<ref name="NEGV" /> Similar to the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]],<ref name="IH" /> it could also target and obliterate [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]],<ref name="FOC">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption]]''</ref> although the vessel on which the superlaser was mounted must be aligned with its target, posing a difficulty to aiming.<ref name="Starships Saga" />

==History==
===Destroyer of worlds===
[[File:Superlaser2.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The axial superlaser was designed to be mounted on starships; smaller in scale compared to the Death Star superlaser.]]
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|war]] against the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] pursued innovations in [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] technology as part of its ambition to wholly dominate [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. To that end, the [[Imperial Department of Military Research/Legends|Imperial Department of Military Research]] developed the Death Stars, which were manufactured by [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] and housed the gargantuan planet-destroying [[Concave Dish Composite Beam Superlaser]]s.<ref name="IH" /> Prior to the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star's]] destruction at the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] had been planning other uses for the superlaser, including mounting it aboard [[Warship/Legends|warships]] as an axial weapon that was much smaller in size.<ref name="Warfare" />

In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="IH date">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]'' mentions the imminent dissolution of the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], placing the [[in-universe]] publication of the ''[[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]'' in that [[Standard year/Legends|year]] as well.</ref> the ''[[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''{{'s}} Imperial Navy section, which was authored by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Conan Antonio Motti/Legends|Conan Antonio Motti]], mentioned the ''Sovereign''-class and ''Eclipse''-class Super Star Destroyers that had been under development. In keeping with the [[Tarkin Doctrine/Legends|Imperial doctrine of fear]], Motti boasted that the destructive potential of their axial superlasers promised to solidify Imperial rule and revolutionize naval combat through the subsequent [[Standard century/Legends|century]]. The admiral further speculated that the ''Sovereign''-class might be commissioned ahead of the ''Eclipse''-class due to its smaller size.<ref name="IH" /> After the loss of the Death Star, [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial forces]] experimented with mounting a superlaser on an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]]&mdash;the [[Conqueror (superlaser)|''Conqueror'']]<ref name="IH" />&mdash;as a replacement,<ref name="Sony">{{SonyCite|url=tradingcardgame/cardsets.vm?set=totc|text=''Star Wars'' Galaxies™ Trading Card Game: Threat of the Conqueror}}</ref> but it was soon destroyed in action over the world [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]].<ref name="IH" />

===Eclipse of an Empire===
{{Quote|I've never seen such an ambitious design&hellip; apart from the Death Star.|Tyber Zann, upon sighting the ''Eclipse''|audio=AmbitiousDesign-FoC.flac|<ref name="FOC" />}}
The Empire wished to test the superlaser technology that would be employed in the ''Eclipse''-class [[Dreadnaught/Legends|dreadnoughts]], two of which were having their keels built in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of two planets&mdash;the [[Eclipse (Eclipse-class)|''Eclipse'']] over [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]], which was home to the Super Star Destroyer manufacturer [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]], and the ''[[Eclipse II]]'' over [[Byss/Legends|Byss]], the Emperor's secret stronghold. The regime thus constructed a superlaser platform dubbed the "[[Tarkin (superweapon)|''Tarkin'']]," though it was [[Infiltration of the Tarkin|destroyed]]<ref name="Warfare" /> in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Nevertheless, advances in superlaser technology led to the new generation of ''Sovereign''-class and ''Eclipse''-class Super Star Destroyers that were successfully launched after the Empire was fractured in the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] of [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], in which the second Death Star was likewise destroyed.<ref name="Databank" />

[[File:Eclipse1.jpg|thumb|left|300px|The Emperor's flagship, the ''Eclipse'', which featured an axial superlaser]]
Following the Battle of Endor, the criminal [[Tyber Zann]]'s [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium]] seized control of the half-constructed ''Eclipse'' during a [[Battle for the Eclipse|battle]] between Imperial and Rebel forces over Kuat. The Consortium used the ''Eclipse''{{'s}} unstable axial superlaser against the Imperials and subsequently abandoned it, with Zann having been satisfied with looting the ship.<ref name="FOC" /> The reborn Emperor Palpatine later used the ''Eclipse'' and the ''Eclipse II'' as his [[Flagship/Legends|flagships]] during his attempted [[Operation Shadow Hand|reconquest]] of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], using them alongside his [[Galaxy Gun]] and [[World Devastator]] superweapons. At the [[Time/Legends|time]], the ''Sovereign''-class' lead ship of the [[Sovereign (Sovereign-class)|same name]] was still being constructed as part of the [[Dark Empire|Emperor's fleet]] in the [[Beshqek system|Byss system]].<ref name="DES">''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> However, Palpatine's forces were destroyed between [[10 ABY/Legends|10]] and [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]] by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="Warfare" />
